primaryMetric: session switch click to matching content at next renderer RAF, median of six switches per independent launch
retentionRule: Reject confirmed functional regressions, repeated ordinary-load slowdown above both gates, or new repeated >50 ms interaction long tasks. Retain only if 500-session primary gain exceeds both thresholds. Diagnose repeated long tasks before deciding. Preserve every failed and anomalous launch.
measurementMethod: Four separate 20-session preflights in ABBA order, excluded from formal data. Then three ABBA groups, one worker, no retries, separate app process per scenario and isolated profile, visible inactive window, fixed 1280x900 at zoom 1, same logical seed for both packages; compare medians/ranges across six independent launches per arm and direction within each group. Both packages retain production source and dependencies, with distinct comparison-only CFBundleIdentifiers to isolate LaunchServices on one remote macOS runner. Wall and renderer RAF metrics remain separate.
